assignments.mission: Using only the provided test facts, recommend A/B/C for the second site. Interpret evidence quality (repeat buys, net-new acquisition, pricing power, HQ-senior dependence, event attendance bias), identify the most misread metric and why, state what 6‑month results would change the call (clear thresholds), and judge if evidence suffices for a 3+ year irreversible investment. Deliver a concise, board-ready rationale with conditionality.

reason: This is a major investment decision based solely on given pilot evidence. It needs one strategist to interpret experimental signals, weigh risks, set decision thresholds, and recommend among A/B/C without external market data. Additional roles would not change the decision.
